༄༅// dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po gdong drug lha nyer gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga smin byed 'dab brgya phye ba'i 'gram chang zhes bya ba bzhugs// sangs rgyas ye shes rang gzugs 'jam dpal dbyangs// lus can nyon mongs dug gsum sbyang ba'i slad// gar dgu'i nyams kyi 'gyur ba cang ston pa'i// bla ma gshin rje'i gshed kyi rtag tu skyongs// dus kyi byin zas sgrib gsum zad mi byed// stong zil lhun po dngos grub zung gis dbul// de dag las ni ye shes khro bo'i sku// yid la byas pa'i bsod nams sgrun du ci// snod bcud snang ba srid pa'i dpal 'byor nyid// ma yin bde chen len pa thar pa'i grong*// kha dog rnam bkra rlung gi rgyal mtshan dngos// min no ye shes lnga mdangs gsal ba'i gzugs// gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag yas sprin// mngon par dkrigs las dbang bzhi'i char gyi rgyun// skal ldan rgyud kyi sa gzhir 'bebs pa yis// sku bzhi'i dbyar skyes bsu ba'i cho ga brtsam// sngon rabs mkhas pa'i gzhung don rnam gsal du// bgyid la nga nyid lhag snyam rgyags min mod// thub dbang sras dang bcas pa'i phrin las rjes// skyong ba kun gyi las nyid 'di yin phyir// de la 'dir bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas/ gshin rje'i gshed gdong drug pa'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma smin par byed pa la/ spyi rgyud las/ rnam dpyad dang po sa gzhi gzung*// gnyis pa sta gon gnas bya ste// nub gsum pa la 'jug pa shis// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sa chog dang*/ sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi ste gsum las/ dang po sa chog la ni lnga/ brtag bslang sbyang gzung bsrung ba'o// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po ni bkra shis shing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas dang sa brtag pa gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa gnyis las/ dang po snang ba las bslang ba ni/

sa'i bdag po gang yin pa las bslang ba'am re zhig g.yar ba'o// gnyis pa mi mngon pa las bslang ba ni/ sa der skyong nul byas nas maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su tshom bu bkod la/ mchod gtor nang mchod rdo rje dril bu sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad tshang bar bshams te/ slob dpon sa'i dbus su 'dug la/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom/ maṇ+ḍal 'og nas 'byung ba ltar sa'i lha mo bskyed pa la mchod pa dang gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ skyob pa sangs rgyas sogs lan gsum brjod pa rnams 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing*/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ sngags de la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ phyogs skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ 'dir bdag gis dkyil 'khor chen po 'dri ba 'tshal gyis/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsal zhing*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ bsam don thams cad chos dang mthun par yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong phrogs mdzod/ ces phrin las bcol/ gtor ma gsum pa sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ yul grong gnas gzhi'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro'i sngags lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po'am ni gzhan// de dag rnams kyis sa gzhi 'di// dkyil 'khor don du bdag la byin// zhes lan gsum brjod la bslang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sa'i skyon rdo dang gyo mo sogs bsal te/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa dbus mtho zhing shar dang byang gzhol ba me long gi ngos ltar byas la ba byung dang dri bzang gis byug go

/gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa ces mang du brjod pas/ lag mthil gnyis las 'od 'phros pas ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs par bsams la sa gnon gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod pas sa nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ zhes pas gser gyi sa gzhir bsam/ de'i steng du rdo rje bcings pa kha sbub la/ oṃ badz+ra me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐ zhes pas sa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bcings par bsam mo// bzhi pa la blos gzung ba dang*/ stang stabs kyi gzung ba gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ sa phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor bzheng bar bya'o snyam pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la/ slob ma bzhi phyogs bzhir dpa' bo bzhi'i nga rgyal gyis gnas te/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ shar nas/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// ces dang*/ lho nas/ phra ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// ces dang*/ nub nas/ 'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// ces dang*/ byang nas/ phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// ces sogs brjod pa'i mthar/ bzhi kas thun mong du/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod// sdig pa thams cad zad byed pa// mgon po dkyil 'khor 'dri bar mdzod// ces gsol ba gdab/ slob ma med na rang gis brjod cing bsam mo// de nas rang gi mig gnyis su/ ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje re re bsams te/ g.yon nas g.yas dang*/ g.yas nas g.yon du blta bas bgegs tshar bcad cing gsos par bsam/ rkang mthil aḥlas sna tshogs rdo rjer bsams la/ rdo rje dang dril bu gsil/ rdo rje'i 'gros kyis sa gzhi bskor zhing*/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥsogs brjod cing dbang ldan du gnas pas bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/

hūm̐ lus ngag yid la gnas pa yi// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /bdag ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// srung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba byed// rdo rje 'bar ba'i bdag nyid kyis// rigs gsum las skyes dgas par byed// ces dang*/ rdo rje'i gnas su 'khor lo dang*// rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gri zhes bsgyur zhing brjod mthar/ sa phyogs 'dir gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dri yis/ 'dir 'du ba las ma gtogs pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad gzhan du song zhig gal te mi 'gro bar gyur na/ ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar dgas par bya'o// hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ khro bo'i sngags dang rol mo drag tu bya'o// spros pa la dga' na stang stabs rnams kyang bya'o// lnga pa ni/ phur bu bcu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las stod ral gri gshin rje'i gshed/ smad phur bu zur gsum par gyur par bsam/ phyogs skyong bcu la sogs pa'i bgegs rnams bkug la/ g.yon gyi phur bus spyi bor btab/ g.yas kyi tho bas brdung bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭān phaṭa/ sarba bigh+nān kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nāṃ kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar btab par bsams la/ phyogs mtshams dang steng 'og gi shar nub gnyis su gdab ste nub dang po'i bya ba'o// gnyis pa sta gon la/ sbyor dngos rjes kyi dang po ni/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sar// dkyil 'khor skya thig btab pa'i dbus// gtso bo lnga yi gnas su ni// dri yi thig le gru bzhi dang*// 'khor gyi gnas su zlum po'i steng*// me tog tshom bu lha grangs dgod// de yi dbus su man ji la// sa lha'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bsham// ras bris ltar na lha nyer gcig

/tshom bu'ang maṇ+ḍal la bkod de// sa lha 'og dang dkyil 'khor gyi// lha yi tshom bu steng dmar bya// de yi phyi rol byang shar gyi// mtshams su mtshams 'dzin me tog dang*// shar nas brtsams te mchod yon sogs// phyogs mtshams nyer spyod g.yas skor bsham// spos dang mar me zhal zas rnams// ci 'byor bshams shing sa lha yi// sgos kyi mchod gtor rnams kyang bsham// byang shar mtshams nas shar lho'i bar// yi dam phyogs skyong chos skyong dang*// mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bcas pa la// gsum bzhi gang mos legs par bsham// logs su sngon 'gro gtor ma'ang bzhag /slob dpon mdun du rdo rje dril// nang mchod gos zung la sogs bsham// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis// mgul chings prog lnga'i bdun pa la// rnam rgyal la ni tho ba sogs// rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan las bum la// sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtshan ma gdags// chu gtsang sum gnyis bkang ba la// sum cu rtsa lnga'i bcud ldan bya// rnam rgyal steng du dung chos sogs// dri bzang chu yis bkang ba dang*// gzungs thag btags pa'i rdo rje gzhag /slob ma sta gon la dgos pa'i// nyer spyod so shing khyor chu dang*// dpung skud ku sha la sogs bsham// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa la/ dngos gzhir bdag bskyed bzlas mchod bstod// gsol gdab bzod gsol dkyil 'khor bsdus// sa lha lha dang bum pa dang*// slob ma lhag gnas rim bzhin bya// zhes te de'ang rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥsogs kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ gtor ma la lag pa g.yon pa bstan te oṃ/ g.yas pa bstan te āḥ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te hoḥzhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hṝḥzhes pa lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi mdzub mo bkug pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya phyogs bcur bskor zhing*/

oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sarba duṣ+ṭ+rāṃ in+d+rā ā dī na sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa gtor snod kyi mthar bkug pa/ 'od gsal gyi mes stong par gyur pa'i ngang las/ skad cig gis gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur gyur ces brjod la/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul nas/ pad skor gyi mthar thal mo kha phye ba dang bcas te/ oṃ in+d+rā ya hrīḥzhes pa nas/ sarba bhū ta bh+yo hā/ ha ha hā/ hi hi hi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ nang mchod oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo zhes pas phul/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms// sogs dang*/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i rjes su/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched du/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba tsam mam/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad srung ba dang*/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad srung ba dang stong grogs mdzod cig muḥzhes dang*/ lag pa g.yas sa la reg pas mgron rnams sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su gshegs par bsam/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba de dag sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig

ces dang*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥsogs bzla zhing rol mo dang dril drag tu dkrol la/ gtor mgron gyi phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams ring du bskrad par bsams la gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal lo// de nas gnas khang dang mchod pa'i yo byad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams āḥlas byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur ces dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar la/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ rdo rje snying gar bzung*/ dril bu rgyun dkrol dang rol mo 'bud dkrol bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe rā ṇi sogs lan gsum gyis gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab bo// de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed mchod bstod nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar gyi bdag bskyed rdzogs par nyams su blang ngo*// sta gon dngos la lnga las/ dang po sa'i lha mo sta gon ni/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis sa'i lha mo ser mo/ phyag g.yas dpang po khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che spras pa/ lte ba yan chad 'thon pa/ g.yas mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan te/

gzhan gsum brkyangs pa la 'bru gsum bkod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing sa la lan gsum brdabs pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas dam tshig par bstim/ de'i mig tu sa snying dkar po sogs skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa rnams byas la/ oṃ rat+na badz+rī a bhi ṣiñca traṃ/ zhes dbang bskur bas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥzhes pas cod paṇa bcings la/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wī lo ka tā rā yai sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gtor ma a kā ros byin gyis brlabs la/ mtshan sngags de la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes lan gsum gyis phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci dga' bar longs spyod cig ces gnang ba byin par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sogs nas/ lho dang nub dang byang dang sgo bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan zhes pa'i bar brjod/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥnas swā hā/ dbus su ma he nag po khro zhing dregs pa dang bcas pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rwa dang rmig pa rno ba/ lce glog ltar 'gyu ba'i steng du/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog mthing nag zhal drug phyag drug sogs nas/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas yab dang lhan cig snyoms par 'jug pa/

gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ oṃ dzi na dzika swā hā/ 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kyi gdan la/ gti mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du/ oṃ rat+na dhṛka swā hā/ lho rtsibs kyi gdan la ser sna rdo rje ser po/ oṃ ā ro lika swā hā/ nub rtsibs kyi gdan la 'dod chags rdo rje/ oṃ pra dz+nyā dhṛka swā hā/ byang rtsibs kyi gdan la phrag dog rdo rje nas/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ lo tsa ni hūm̐/ me'i rtsibs kyi gdan la sa rdo rje ma/ oṃ mā ma kī traṃ/ srin po'i rtsibs kyi gdan la chu rdo rje ma/ oṃ paṇ+ḍa rā hrīḥrlung gi rtsibs kyi gdan la me rdo rje ma/ oṃ tā rā aḥ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs kyi gdan la rlung rdo rje ma ljang gu nas sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog oṃ badz+ra ā be sha hoḥ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ nang gi grwa bzhi'i mer sgeg mo// oṃ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ srin por phreng ba ma/ oṃ badz+ra gī tī hrīḥ rlung du rdo rje glu ma/ oṃ badz+ra nri t+ya aḥ dbang ldan du rdo rje gar ma/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ phyi'i grwa bzhi'i mer rdo rje bdug pa ma/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ srin por rdo rje me tog ma/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hrīḥ rlung du rdo rje mar me ma/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe aḥ dbang ldan du rdo rje dri chab ma ljang gu nas/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gyi phyag mtshan rgyan cha rnams sgrub thabs ltar gsal gdab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa gong ltar spyan drangs/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad de/ mchod yon zhabs bsil phul nas/ dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu k+ṣiṃ las sa snying sogs nas/ kun tu bzang po sngon po/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po nas gnas gsum du bcug lha thams cad kyi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' sogs dam rgya dang*/ de dag gi lce'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje tshogs chos rgya dang*/ oṃ satwa badz+ri a bhi ṣiñca sogs nas byang shar ba la don grub kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya hoḥzhes pa'i bar rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// mchod pa 'bul ba la/ thog mar mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ thog mar phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ dri med gtsang mar sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya mān+ta ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad 'dra ba las/ zhabs bsil 'di zhes dang*/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di// tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis 'dra'o// badz+ra puṣ+pes me tog dang*/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug spos 'di// badz+ra dhū pes bdug spos dang*// dri med yid 'ong gsal ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mar me 'di// badz+ra ā lo kes mar me dang*/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i dri mchog 'di// badz+ra gan+dhes dri mchog dang*/

kha dog ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal zas 'di// badz+ra nai wi d+yes zhal zas dang*/ zin dang ma zin yid 'ong ba'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i sil snyan 'di// badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis sil snyan dang*/ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta sogs brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya ste 'di dag ni phyi mchod do// de nas nang mchod nas mthe bong dang srin lag gis gtor te/ oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas bzang po pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ nag po pa/ bha da pa/ da ma pa/ de ba pa/ dzai tā ri/ a naṅga badz+ra/ dharmā kā sha ma ti/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ rong pa shes rab seng ge bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin chen grub/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ mkhan chen rig 'dzin rgyal po/ rje btsun chos rig rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bsod nams dpal 'byor/ byang gling pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rje btsun tshul khrims bkra shis/ dad sgrol rin chen rgya mtsho/ chos rje kun dga' bsam 'grub/ mtshungs med byams pa rab brtan/ gong dkar ba kun dga' dar rgyas la sogs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag mnos/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥsogs lha nyer gcig gi sngags kyi mthar/

bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel pa'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod de/ myangs pas lus kyi lha rnams tshim par bsam/ gtor ma la bar phud bran la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan srung dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra sogs brjod cing rang gis kyang myang*/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa sogs brgyad kyis mchod pa dang*/ kye kye gshin rje'i gshed nag po nas/ gar mdzad 'gro ba yongs la gzigs// bstod pa ni/

dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan pa'i zhes sogs nas kun du las kyi rgyal la 'dud// ces pa'i bar gyis bstod do// de nas snyan dbab pa ni/ bdug spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gshin rje'i gshed po bcom ldan 'das// rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// sang ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// bcom ldan 'das la bdag gus pas// bka' drin zhu ba gnang ba dang*// sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang*// byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang*// sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*// sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// sang ni dkyil 'khor chen po'i ming*// gshin rje'i gshed po zhes bya ba// cho ga bzhin du bgyid lags na// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas ni// tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab ste/ de dag gi zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo// gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ rgya ston gyis sa lha'i gong du bshad kyang 'dir byas na gzhan gyi 'gros mtshungs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bum pa gnyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis khar brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum par 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/

shar dang mtshams bzhi phyi nang rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ lho dang nub dang byang dang*/ phyi'i phyogs bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su ma he nag po khro zhing dregs pa dang bcas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rwa dang rmig pa rno ba/ lce glog ltar 'gyur ba'i steng du/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog mthing nag zhes pa nas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kyi gdan la gti mug rdo rje dkar po sogs dang*/ lho rtsibs kyi gdan la ser sna rdo rje ser po sogs dang*/ nub rtsibs kyi gdan la 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po sogs dang*/ byang rtsibs kyi gdan la phrag dog rdo rje nas bzhugs pa'o// me'i rtsibs kyi gdan la/ sa rdo rje ma sogs nas mtshams bzhir rigs 'gre/ shar du rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po sogs phyogs bzhir 'gre/ mer sgeg mo dkar mo sogs bzhi dang*/ de'i phyi rol gyi bdug pa ma dkar mo sogs nas/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar sku mdog phyag mtshan gsal gdab/ las thams cad pa'i bum par khro bo bgegs mthar byed nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshin rje'i gshed lha nyi shu rtsa gcig bgegs mthar byed dang bcas pa'i rnam pa can gyi ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ dbang bskur nas/ byang dang byang shar ba dang*/ bgegs mthar byed la don grub kyis dbur brgyan/

oṃ badz+ra tu ṣ+yo hoḥzhes pa'i bar gyis lha bskyed la/ mtshan sngags re re sngon du 'gro ba'i rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ sogs dang*/ oṃ dzi na dzika swā hā/ oṃ rat+na dhṛka swā hā/ oṃ ā ro lika swā hā/ oṃ pradz+nyā dhṛka swā hā/ zhes sogs rang rang gi sngags sam/ mi nus na hūm̐ buṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.aḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥhūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.aḥ lan gnyis dang hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gshin rje'i gshed nyi shu rtsa gcig bgegs mthar byed dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐ sogs brgyad dang*/ kye kye gshin rje'i gshed nag po// zhes sogs kyis mchod/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// gshin rje'i gshed po shin tu 'jigs// ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin// sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal// ser sna rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// gshin rje'i gshed po shin tu 'jigs// sems kyi rdo rje rab tu gsal// rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal// 'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// khyab bdag chags pa chos 'byung gnas// dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal// phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// gshin rje'i gshed po kun las byed// sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba// phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs sh+lau ka dang bcas pas bstod la/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song*/ bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs bskul/ sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ gtso bo la hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥbargya rtsa dang*/

'khor rnams la rang rang gi sngags dang*/ las bum la/ oṃ āḥbi gh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī ye hūm̐ bzlas mthar mchod bstod byas la 'dod don zhus/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol nas/ las bum la kha rgyan gyis bum chu 'thor zhing*/ dbang gi bya ba mthar ma phyin bar gyi bgegs bzlog par mdzod cig ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i chur bsam mo// de nas mngon par bshams pa'i gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi

gtor ma 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa so sor mdzad 'dug kyang lag len bde bas gcig tu byas so// snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje'i gshed lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa spros/ phyogs skyong bcu bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥw-i kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sarba duṣ+ṭān in+d+rā ya ā dī na sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor yug tu 'khod pa ni/ shar du brgya byin ser skya mig stong dang ldan pa glang po che la zhon pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ de'i g.yon du nye dbang nam mkha' lding la zhon pa rin po che'i cod paṇa can/ g.yas na dbyug tho dang 'khor lo/ g.yon na dung dang nor bu kostu bha thogs pa/ lhor gshin rje'i sngon po ma he la zhon pa skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa/ sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po gter gyi bum pa la bzhugs pa/ bī dza pū ra dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang po la zhon pa/ rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin cing gau rī la 'khyud pa/ de'i drung du tshogs bdag dkar po byi ba la gnas la/ g.yas na phreng ba dang dgra s+t+wa/ g.yon na la phug dang la du 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa/ bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro la zhon pa/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang sngon sha ba la zhon pa rlung ras 'dzin pa/ steng du zla ba dkar po ku mu dā'i steng na 'dug pa/ ku mu dā 'dzin pa/ nyi ma dmar po rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa pad+ma 'dzin pa/ tshangs pa ser po gdong bzhi pa ngang pa la zhon pa/ g.yas spyi blugs dang mi 'jigs pa dang*/ g.yon dbyug pa dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ 'og tu sa'i lha mo ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa/

bum pa 'dzin pa/ thag zangs ris sngon po shing rta la zhon pa/ ral gri dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ de dag gi 'khor du srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba/ rang gi snying nas gshin rje'i gshed spros nas phur bus btab ste/ ye shes pa'i skur bsgyur ba rnams sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul nas/ thog mar 'das pa'i gtor ma phul ba/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs te gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kri tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhak+ṣa ya bhak+ṣa ya hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ swā hā/ zhes lan bdun dang*/ oṃ in+d+rā ya hrīḥya mā yaṣ+ṭ+rīḥ wa ru ṇā ya wi/ ku be rā ya kṛ/ i shwa rā ya ta/ ag+na ye a/ nair ri t+yā ya na/ wā ya we na/ tsan+d+rā ya hūm̐/ ar+gha ya hūm̐/ brah+ma ṇā ya phaṭa/ ba sun+dha rā ya phaṭa/ bi ma tsa trā ya swā/ sarba bhū te bh+yo hā/ ha ha ha hī hī hī hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la me tog la sogs pa phyi nang yid byung gi mchod pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod sogs kyis bstod/ gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor bcas kun// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// dkon mchog gsum la smod pa dang*// dam pa'i chos ni 'jig pa dang*// dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrog dang*// 'gro yongs 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs 'di// ngan song gsum du mngon par 'gro// thugs rjes bsgral ba'i dus la bab// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal las// tshe 'di nyid la bral bar mdzod// ces phrin bcol bas lha rnams kyis/

ha ha hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing mnyes nas dngos grub stsol bar bsam mo// gtor ma gnyis pa dang gsum pa gur gyi mgon po dang*/ zhal bzhi pa la rang rang gi cho gas dbul/ bzhi pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis bsngo/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// bzhi pa slob ma dbang bskur dang 'brel ba na sta gon la bcu gsum ste/ lus kyi bya ba maṇ+ḍa 1 la 'bul// bur 2 bya spro ba 3 skyed bdun rnam 4 dag /sdom ga 5 zung byin rlab 6 sa mchod pas 7 mchod// so 8 shing khyor chu 9 ku 10 sha sbyin// srung 11 skud chos bshad 12 rmi lam 13 brtag /ces pa ltar las/ dang po ni bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa la slob ma sta gon gyi chos zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gnyis pa ni/ slob ma bla ma gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i zhal du bcug ste/ gsang gnas su gti mug gshin rje'i gshed du gnas pa la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs nas zhal du zhugs nas dbang bskur sbyor mtshams nas phyir byung nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// gshin rje sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor du// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum/ gsum pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// dus gsum 'byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// rdo rje gsang sngags mthu yis ni// ye shes mnyam pa med pa brnyes// shākya seng ge sogs mchog gi /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa// gang gi stobs kyis bdud kyi sde// shin tu mi bzad che bcom nas// 'jig rten rjes 'jug spyad nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ces so// bzhi pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs lan gsum/ lnga pa ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ngo*// drug pa ni/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri'i thig le byas la/ dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// bdun pa ni/ slob ma la mchod pa lngas mchod do// brgyad pa ni/ ba byung lngas maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa tshom bu lnga pa byas la/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing byin te/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyi bsangs la/ so'i rtsa ba drud der dor bas sdig pa dag par sgoms shig ces brjod do// slob mas shar ram byang du bltas te/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes pas dor ro// shar du rtse mo bstan na zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa spyod/ mtshams rnams su dngos grub phran tshegs 'grub bo// dgu pa ni/ waṃ las byung ba'i chu la waṃ lan bdun brjod pa/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥdharmāḥsarba pā paṃ nish+tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpan a pa na ya hūm̐ zhes pas khyor chu lan gsum 'thung du gzhug go /bcu pa ni/ dhīḥdang hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha la/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa dhīḥ.oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇā hūm̐ zhes brjod de/ lag pa g.yas dang g.yon du byin la/ che ba stan dang chung ba sngas su bya'o// bcu gcig pa ni/ srung skud dmar po lus dang mnyam pa la sum sgril du byas par/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥbazlas te mdud pa gsum byas pa rdo rje'i thag par bsams la/ oṃ bud+dha mai tri rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbān swā hā/ zhes pas skyes pa'i gru mo g.yon/ bud med kyi g.yas su gdags so// bcu gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig

/'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla med byed par nus pa yin// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rang byung skal ba chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// zhes brjod do// bcu gsum pa ni/ slob ma rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi khang par ku sha'i sngas stan la mgo dkyil 'khor la phyogs te/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥbazlas te nyal du gzhug rmi lam ngan na hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥbazlas pa'i srung skud 'dogs pa'am/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs pa la sogs pas rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byin pa'i thabs kyang bya'o// zhes bsgos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ yid mchod/ bstod pa rnams kyi mthar/ dngos grub blangs nas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/

ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog cing*/ oṃ badz+ra ut+tiṣ+ṭha/ sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ slar yang mchod bstod bya'o// gtor mgron gzhan rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs nas brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sogs nas/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang oṃ badz+ra muḥrten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la bstim nas/ skye mched sogs bsrungs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo'o// lnga pa thig tshon sta gon ni/ rdul tshon gyi phyogs ltar na/ las kyi thig chen brgyad cha chen bcu drug cha phran dang bcas pa legs par gdab/ ye shes kyi thig gis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ thig skud kha dog lnga re re zhing sboms su pañca re khā'i lnga cha/ ring thung dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur du byas la tshon dang lhan cig tu byin gyis brlabs te/ thod pa sogs snod lnga'i nang du thig skud lnga dang*/ tshon sna lnga la rdo rje'i rtses gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga'i sa bon hūm̐ buṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ rnams bris la rang rang gi phyogs su bzhag mchod pa lnga bshams la/ thig tshon bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga bskyed/ mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rjer bsam/ 'bar ba'i lta bas nam mkha'i lha las ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/

oṃ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭa aṃ ku sha dzaḥzhes brjod la mchod bstod bya/ mtheb mdzub kyis mnye zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i thig tshon du bsams la/ thig skud rim par brkyangs te/ oṃ a n+yo ྅ n+ya a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmāḥpa ra s+pha ra a nu ga tāḥsarba dharmāḥ.a t+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmaḥ zhes brjod de/ thig skud lnga gcig tu bsgril nas rdo rje la dkris te bdud rtsis gtor/ slob dpon nub nas shar du bltas/ slob mas shar nas nub tu bltas te/ gtso bo dang gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa gnyis kas dzaḥdzaḥzhes brjod cing lte ba'i thad ka tsam du thig skud 'then te/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs// khyed kyis 'gro don mdzad dus lags// khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol ba// thig skud sgra yis bskul ma 'debs// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ mā ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes slob dpon gyis brjod de/ lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mtheb srin gyi steng nas gcus nas steng dang*/ 'og nas gcus nas 'og tu gdab/ de bzhin du gnyis po rgyab sprad cing g.yas skor gyis slob dpon lho dang slob ma byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi logs thig slob dpon rlung dang slob ma srin por gnas pas nub kyi logs thig slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang gi logs thig slob dpon me dang slob ma srin por gnas pas lho'i logs thig gdab/ rgyab 'gros spangs te/ slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po dang*/ slob dpon bden bral dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa ste/ nyis bsdebs dang po slob dpon dang phyi ma slob mas gdab bo// oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hoḥzhes pas ye thig gi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg la/

slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas dbus su zhugs te/ khro bo'i lta bas phyogs bzhir blta zhing*/ oṃ badz+rod+gha ṭa ya sa ma ya prā we sha hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas sgo dbye bar bsams la sgo'i thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dbye'o// slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas shar du bltas te/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis tshon rtsi dkar po blangs la/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed// gshin rje'i gshed po rgyal chen gyi// snying po'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// oṃ sa ma ya tsi tra mā ti hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar po ser po dmar po ljang gu nag pos bris/ pañca re khā thod pas bkab ste rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pas mnan te me tog sogs lngas mchod/ rtsig pa sbrel ran gyi bar du kha mi dbye/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes pas dbus kyi phur bu phyung la phur shul tshon sna lngas dgang*/ de nas slob mas lag len ltar bris mthar/ ye thig dang tshon gyi lhag ma mchod de/ ye shes pa sta gon gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim mo// ye thig nam mkhar bteg pa bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis su med par thim par bsams la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod do// rdul tshon gyi phyogs la spos rol mo dang bcas pas/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal dang*/ las kyi rdo rjes las bum bzung la yi ge brgya pa brjod kyin dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas la/ lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar bdag la'am bdag dang slob ma la dbang bskur du gsol zhes dang lha de dang de'i mdun nas bum pa 'bul tshul du byas la/ rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor gyi shar dang las bum bigh+nān+ta kṛta zlos shing dkyil 'khor gyi las kyi bar chad thams cad bsrung du gsol zhes brjod de dbang ldan du gzhag ras bris ltar na gzhi gtsang ma'i steng du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor rab gnas can zhal shar du phyogs par dgram mo// nub gsum pa dngos gzhi la/

sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba'o// dang po la/ dkyil 'khor mtha' skor dris byugs la// spyi dang so so'i mchod pa rnams// rdul tshon ltar na zlum po dang*// ras bris yin na gru bzhir bsham// 'jig rten dang 'das sngon 'gro dang*// phyi rol gtor mchod bcas pa dang*// maṇ+ḍal dbang bskur byed pa la// mig ras me tog gu gul dang*// rigs drug mchod pa dbu rgyan dang*// rdo rje dril bu gdong drug sku// tho ba ral gri rdo rje zhags// gtun shing dril bu thod dbyug dang*// mda' gzhu mig thur me long dang*// rgya gram 'bud dung 'khor lo dang*// pusti snam sbyar bdud rtsi sogs// nyer mkho thams cad nyer bsdogs bya// zhes pa ltar ro// de nas stan la 'khod de/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang ba nas brtsams te bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas dang dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar nyams su blang ngo*// de nas rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis/ rdo rje gtsug gtor ram rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog pa dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra bi gā kra ma hoḥrang nyid dkyil 'khor bteg pa'i 'og nas dbus su zhugs par mos la/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gshin rje'i gshed zhal drug pa yab yum gyi rnam pas 'khod par gyur ces brjod la/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i nas/ lho dang nub dang byang dang sgo bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du bris pa'i mtshan ma rnams lha so so'i sa bon hūm̐ buṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ/ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐ traṃ hṝḥ.aḥhūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.aḥrnams su gyur pa las/ lha so so'i skur gyur pa ni/ dbus su ma he nag po khro zhing dregs pa dang bcas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rwa dang rmig pa rno ba/

lce glog ltar 'gyur ba'i steng du/ rang dang tha mi dad par bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog mthing nag sogs nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kyi gdan la gti mug rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa sogs nas/ dbang ldan du dri chab ma ljang gu nas zhi ba dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar lha so so'i sngags rnams dor ba min pa lha sta gon bzhin brjod/ de nas rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa nas lhan cig skyes dga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu nas ko3haṃ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas par gyur ces pa tsam mam/ spro na yum gyi mkhar babs pa thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du lha so so'i gdan srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas par gyur/ cha gcig cha nyi shu rtsa gcig tu gyur pa lha nyer gcig tu gyur pa ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed yab yum/ 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kyi gdan la gti mug rdo rje/ lho rtsibs kyi gdan la ser sna rdo rje/ nub rtsibs kyi gdan la 'dod chags rdo rje/ byang rtsibs kyi gdan la phrag dog rdo rje/ me'i rtsibs kyi gdan la sa rdo rje ma/ srin po'i rtsibs kyi gdan la chu rdo rje ma/ rlung rtsibs kyi gdan la me rdo rje ma/

dbang ldan gyi rtsibs kyi gdan la rlung rdo rje ma/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog byang sgor rdo rje dril bu/ nang gi grwa bzhir mer sgeg mo/ srin por phreng ba ma/ rlung du rdo rje glu ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje gar ma/ phyi'i grwa bzhi'i mer rdo rje bdug pa ma/ srin po rdo rje me tog ma/ rlung du rdo rje mar me ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje dri chab rnams su gyur/ ces mtshan tsam brjod pas gsal gdab/ de nas/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥsogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ slar gcig tu 'dus/ rang nyid phyi'i gtso bo'i snying gar thim pas/ rang nyid zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed du gyur pa ni sku mdog mthing nag sogs brjod/ oṃ dzi na dzika swā hā/ mkha' nang gi gti mug rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ zhes pa nas/ slar 'dus srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar lha rnams rang rang gis sngags kyis phyung*/ gnas de dang der rdul tshon gyi lha dang bsres la dgod do// ye shes pa dgug pa la dngos gzhi thog mar sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥsogs kyis mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul bas/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥsogs kyis dgug gzhug bcing dbang du byas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sogs kyis ye shes pa gong ltar spyan drangs pa dang bgegs bskrad de/ mchod yon zhabs bsil gyis mchod de bstim pa dang*/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ dbang bskur rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs pa rnams ni sgrub thabs ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// 'dir byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod la/

rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ mar me la sogs pa sbar te mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ yid byung mchod pa rnams sta gon ltar byas la/ gzhan yang la li ta'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i mchod pa nyi shu pa ni/ ༈ dkyil 'khor pa kun rnam par dag bya'i phyir// mi gtsang rnyog bral rin chen rdul g.yab mchog /gus pas blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi// dgyes shing 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ra dza wa ra ṇaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur steng du g.yas pa'i gru mo bzhag ste rnga yab g.yob tshul lo// dkyil 'khor pa kun nyer 'tshe bral ba'i phyir// mi mthun phyogs 'joms nor bu'i sbrang g.yab mchog /gus pas blo yis blangs nas dbul bar bgyi// dgyes shing 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// ma sha ka wa ra ṇaṃ/ tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis dang sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba sbyar la phyag rgya gong dang 'dra/ dkyil 'khor pa kun bsil grib myong ba'i phyir// tsha gdung 'joms byed yid 'ong bsil yab mchog /byan+dza naṃ/ phyag rgya gong dang 'dra/ dkyil 'khor pa kun brtan par bzhugs bya'i phyir// yangs shing mdzes pa yid 'ong gzhal med khang*// bi ni/ kun rig pho brang zlum po'i rgya// dkyil 'khor pa kun bde bar rol pa'i phyir// ljon shing me tog rnam bkra skyed mos tshal// ud+ya naṃ/ pho brang gru bzhi'i rgya/ dkyil 'khor pa kun thun mtshams ngal gso'i phyir// dar zab la sogs bde stegs gzigs mal mchog /sha ya ā sa naṃ/ gzims cha'i rgya/ dkyil 'khor pa kun rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs phyir// rin chen du mas brgyan pa seng ge'i khri// khaṭa ṭ+wa/

seng ge'i gdan rgya/ dkyil 'khor pa kun 'gro don la gshegs phyir// rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan myur 'gro cang shes khyu// rat+na a shwa/ rta mchog rgya/ dkyil 'khor pa kun theg chen sar gnas phyir// shin tu stobs ldan glang chen du ma'i tshogs// ga dzaḥ glang chen rgya/ dkyil 'khor pa kun 'gro ba'i re skong phyir// dgos dgu 'byung ba'i yid bzhin rin po che// tsin+tā ma ṇi/ rin chen rgya/ dkyil 'khor pa kun gos rgyan sogs spyod phyir// 'dod pa'i dngos ster dpag bsam shing ljon pa// kalpa bṛk+ṣā/ thal mo khong stong*/ dkyil 'khor pa kun gzhal yas khang brgyan phyir// gdugs 'khor ri dwags mchog mdzes rta babs bzang*// twa ra ṇa/ gong 'dra/ dkyil 'khor pa kun steng du rab brgyan phyir// char sogs rlan pas gnod sel bla re mchog /bi tā naṃ/ bla re'i rgya/ dkyil 'khor pa kun ljags dbang tshim bya'i phyir// sku lus rgyas byed bza' btung ro sna tshogs// an+naṃ pā naṃ/ khu tshur gnyis bshos 'bul tshul/ dkyil 'khor pa kun sgrub la snyan gsan phyir// sngags kyi rang bzhin snyan pa'i glu dbyangs dag /gī ti/ pi waṃ rgya/ dkyil 'khor pa kun sgrub pas mnyes bya'i phyir// lha yi ting 'dzin gsal byed gar dag gis// nṛ t+ya/ gar ma'i phyag chen/ dkyil 'khor pa kun rtag tu mchod bya'i phyir// zad pa med pa'i gter gyi bum pa bzang*// bha dra gha ṭa/ thal mo khong stong*/ dkyil 'khor pa kun rgyun mi chad mchod phyir// ci 'dod rgyun ldan 'dod 'jo'i ba mchog khyu// kā ma dhe nu/ thal mo khong stong*/ dkyil 'khor pa kun bral ba med pa'i phyir// gang 'dod 'bras 'byung rin chen yal ga'i lag /rat+na hasta/ glang po'i rgya/ dkyil 'khor pa kun rang gi 'bras spyod phyir// mtha' dbus med par gang ba nam mkha'i mdzod// kha gañja/ thal mo khong stong sbyar ba'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

bstod pa dril gsil gdangs dang bcas te/ dur khrod rgyan gyis rnam brgyan nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa rnams kyis bstod do// de nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam pas bye ste rang gnas su 'khod ces brjod/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad de sgrub grogs zhig gis hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥbazla zhing dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug rang nyid sgrub grogs dang bcas te sgrub khang gi phyi rol lam/ yol ba'i phyi rol du/ ji ltar rigs pa'i stegs la gtor ma gcig dang*/ g.yas su chu gnyis dang*/ g.yon du nyer spyod lnga mdun nas rgyab tu sgreng tshar du bsham/ mdun du nang mchod kyang bshams la/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo lcags kyu dang zhags pa sogs nas ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gtor snod gyi mthar/ shar du brgya byin ser skya sogs rgyas par brjod/ mi nus na sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar ming tsam brjod pas gsal gdab la phur bus btab nas 'das par bsgyur ba dang*/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul la/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bar mos te/ oṃ in+d+rā ya hrīḥ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms// dpa' bo gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa// gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing*// phyogs skyong bco lnga'i tshogs la 'dud// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhes sogs nas stong grogs mdzod cig ces pa'i bar sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs bzhin brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes zhal zas nas rim pas g.yas skor du mchod pa rnams gtor snod nang du bsdu/ mthar mchod yon gyis gtor snod la bskor te 'gro phyogs su bsgrengs la/

slob dpon gyis mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥsarba pā paṃ nish+tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas gnas gsum bsrungs la/ muḥzhes dang*/ lag pa g.yas sa la brkyangs te/ gtor mgron sgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams rnams su gshegs par bsams shing*/ sgrub mchod rjes ma'i nyin ye shes pa gshegs/ zhes brjod/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs zhes sogs sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin brjod de/ gtor ma ring du dor la hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥzlos shing rol mos mtshams bcad/ nang du 'ongs nas yol ba bsal te yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ dngos sam yid kyis dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas mthar/ shar du 'greng ste 'dud pa dang bcas pas/ bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang*/ cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrubs pa la skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa/ de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing rdor dril du bcas pas phyag gsum bya'o// dngos gzhi gnyis pa man chad la skabs 'dir bum bskyed sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya'o// gnyis pa 'jug cing dbang blang ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang por las bum gyi chus kha bshal te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas khrus byas la/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla mar mos te/ bla mas mdzad dgos pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang*/ dbang rdzas 'grim pa rnams de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i gshin rje'i gshed cig gis mdzad par bsams la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/

bgegs bskrad pa'i phyir/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas lus ngag yid la gnas pa'i bgegs bskrad/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i mig dar dmar po/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra ma ṇā ya hūm̐ zhes pas bcing*/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i me tog phreng ba/ u dum wā ra man+dā ra// yongs 'du dang ni māl+li ka /kar+ṇi ka yi phreng ba 'di// legs par nos te bu khyod zung*// ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes me tog phreng ba gtad do// gsol ba gdab pa ni/ e ma ho sangs rgyas slob dpon che// e ma ho chos dang tshogs kyi gtso// e ma ho khro bo 'jigs mdzad pa// bai ta lī dang kha sbyor ba'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// de nyid dam tshig rim pa dang*// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du'o// yan lag bdun pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes lan gsum dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes pa lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ngo*// byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ sta gon ltar gnas gsum du yas mar du reg ste 'bru gsum brjod/ nang gi sems bskyed pa ni/ snying gar rdo rje bzung la/ sa ma ya a zhes pas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro bar bsgom/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi zhes pas sems bskyed pa de/ oṃ su rā te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas brtan par byas/ gsang bar gdams pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang chen dam pa 'di/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re zhes brjod do// dris lan bya ba ni/ kye bu sdug pa khyod su yin/ zhes dris la/ lan du/ bskal pa bzang po dang ldan pa bdag lags so// ci la dga'/ zhes pa'i lan du/ bde ba chen po la'o// de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes pa'i lan du/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes brjod do// nang du 'khrig pa ni/ rang nyid gti mug gshin rje'i gshed du bsams la/ lag tu rdo rje gtad la/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas yol ba'i nang du khrid par bsam mo// nang gi 'jug pa la/ phyag 'tshal ba'i phyir/ oṃ badz+rod+gha ṭa sa ma ya prā we sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas gzhal yas khang gi sgo bzhi phye bar bsam/ oṃ na ma te hūm̐/ na ma mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ zhes pas sku gsung thugs la phyag bya/ shar sgo nas zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pas+thā nā ya/ āt+mā nāṃ ni r+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ/ zhes pas gtso bo la'o// gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo spyi bor sbyar te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza ta thā ga tā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bai ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ zhes pas gti mug gshin rje'i gshed la'o// lho nas phra ma gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo dpral ba dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+mā nāṃ ni r+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes pas ser sna gshin rje'i gshed la'o// nub nas 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo mgrin pa dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra war+t+ta nā ya āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharmā pra war+t+tā ya māṃ/

zhes pas 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed la'o// byang sgo nas phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis thal mo spyi bo dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karmā ṇi/ āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes pas phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed la phyag bya'o// bsdus pa la dga' na sku gsung thugs kyi phyag gis chog go /dam la gzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag snying gar rdo rje bzung ste/ gshin rje gshed po deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes nyes dmigs dang*/ dri'i chu rnam rgyal bum chu bsres pa blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// ci ste dam tshig las 'das na// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas ni// bdun rgyud rigs ni brlag par byed// de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang*// sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka'// shin tu mos pas bsrung bar gyis// pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha zhes gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par byed do// zhes dam tshig rdo rje'i sgo nas so// rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/

deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal gshin rje'i gshed po nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la'ang brnyas par mi bya ste/ byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par/ tshe'i dus byas nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes pas bla ma'i dka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag nas/ nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi'i ye shes dbab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal gshin rje'i gshed po bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo// rang nyid gtso bor gsal ba'i rkang 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ rkang mthil du dzhaiṃ dmar po/ snying gar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po waṃ gyis mtshan pa/ spyi bor gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams bsam/ rkang zhabs kyi rlung gis rkang mthil gyi me sbar/ snying ga'i sa'i dkyil 'khor bsregs/ mgrin pa'i chu bkol/ spyi gtsug gi lha lus la bstim/ me'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par char bzhin du babs par bsam zhing*/ bdag 'jug gi tshe gu gul la sogs pa'i rdzas kyis bdug pa mi mdzad/ rol mo dang bcas te/ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥ'i mthar/ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ/ zhes pas dbab/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ slob ma'i tshe lce la a bsgoms la/ rdo rje chos ni mgon po che// snang ba mtha' yas bde ba che// smros shig 'dod chags chos chen po// rdo rje dge dang mi dge smros// zhes brjod do// dkyil 'khor la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// gshin rje'i gshed dpal grong khyer mchog

/snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /'dis ni dngos grub gang 'grub dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod dang ldan// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces brjod de/ dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir/ bar snang gi kha dog dri/ dkar pos zhi ba/ ser pos rgyas pa/ dmar pos dbang*/ nag pos drag po/ sna tshogs kyis las sna tshogs 'grub bo// zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// 'dod chags rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// phrag dog rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes bstod pa'i rjes su/ dkyil 'khor la me tog dor te/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas dor ba na/ gzhan 'jug pa'i tshe/ dbus su phog na thugs/ shar du sku/ lhor yon tan/ nub tu gsung*/ byang du phrin las/ bar du lhung na gang nye ba/ mnyam na gnyis ka sku stod la phog na mchog rked par 'bring*/ sku smad la phog na tha ma/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du lhung na bskyar te dor ro// mig ras dbye ba ni/ mig gnyis su oṃ bsgoms la/ oṃ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te/ rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥzhes pas mig ras bsal bar mos nas/ dkyil 'khor la blta ba ni/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// me tog gang du lhung gyur pa// de ni khyod kyi rigs kyi lha// zhes pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skye// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// he badz+ra pa sh+ya zhes brjod de/

rten dang brten par bcas pa mthong bar mos la/ de nas bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i zhabs la phyag bya bar mos la/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so// oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor bdag gis de ring mthong*// oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur// sa ma ya hoḥzhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa zhugs nas dbang blang ba la/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis las/ dang por rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ ji ltar rdo rje 'chang chen pos// rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin slob dpon khyod kyis kyang*// dbang mchog dam pa stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta sogs brjod cing bgegs bskrad par bsam/ bdag 'jug gi tshe gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i gshin rje'i gshed des byed par bsams la dngos su rang gis/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ bar gyis dkyil 'khor mchod de/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang gis 'gro bskyab phyir// yon tan 'byung gnas byin pa ltar// de bzhin slob ma 'di rnams la// dbang mchog dam pa stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa la/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal nas kyang*/ bu de rnams dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin na dbang bskur cig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo// dbang bskur ba lnga las/ thog mar mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang la/ nang dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma gtso bor gnas pa la/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// thugs kyi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ rang dang dbang rdzas bum pa mi dmigs te stong par gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum mā ma kī dang gnyis su med par mnyam par sbyor ba/ gtso bo yab yum gyi zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar 'thon pa hūm̐ las rdo rje tho ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog mthing nag sogs nas me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso bo yab yum du bskyed/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshin rje'i gshed yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ bla ma dang gtso bo dbyer med pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub sems kyi rnam pas/ yum gyi mkhar rang dang dbang rdzas gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan cig byung*/ de gnyis yum gyi mkha' nas 'thon te/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'khod/ dbang rdzas kyi lha 'od du zhu ba rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mi bskyod pas gtso bor byas pa'i rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu/ sgo ba bzhi/ sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro pho mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ phyi'i dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchog chen ji ltar gsol ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// rdo rje'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas byin gyis brlabs/ yum bzhis bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi bum pa'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// bum pa'i dbang mchog blang bar mdzod// ces sbyin par gdams nas/

dbang dngos ni/ bum chu spyi bor blugs la/ bum pa'i dbang bskur chen po mchog /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca māṃ su ra ti s+t+waṃ a haṃ zhes dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sems can ma lus rang bzhin kun gyi mchog gyur pa// skyed byed kyis bskyed bde ba thams cad 'byung ba ji lta bar// de ltar dbang bskur mchog gis 'dir ni bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra ha/ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raṃ/ badz+ra dharma gā ya ni/ badz+ra karmāḥka ro bha we/ zhes rdo rje'i glu blangs/ khro bo rnams kyis/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod pas mchod de dbang bskur/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dbang bskur mkhan gyi lha rnams rang la thim pas/ rang gi snying gar mi bskyod pa/ spyi bor rnam snang*/ mgrin par snang mtha'/ lte bar rin 'byung*/ gsang gnas su don grub/ sa'i khams la sangs rgyas spyan ma/ chu'i khams la mā ma kī/ me'i khams la gos dkar mo/ rlung gi khams la dam tshig sgrol ma/ mig tu sa snying*/ rna bar phyag rdor/ snar nam snying*/ lcer spyan ras gzigs/ dpral bar sgrib pa rnam sel/ snying gar kun tu bzang po/ phyag sor bcu la khro bo bcu/ zhabs sor bcu la khro mo bcu/ yan lag bzhi la sgo ba bzhi/ mkha' 'gro pho mo ba spu'i tshogs la thim/ khyad par du gtso bo yab yum gyi skur gyur/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod pa bya/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/

zhe sdang gi sgrib pa dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no// rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi dbang la/ nang dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa/ gtso bo ser sna gshin rje'i gshed du gnas pa la/ dpal ldan yon tan rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// yon tan rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rang dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan stong pa'i ngang las/ dbu rgyan buṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ las rigs lnga/ rang nyid aṃ las rin po che aṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma dang gnyis su med par mnyam par sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar 'thon pa aṃ las ser sna gshin rje'i gshed du gong ltar bskyed cing*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub sems kyi rnam pas yum gyi mkhar rang dang dbang rdzas ser sna gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas thim/ de gnyis yum gyi mkhar nas phyir 'thon/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi lhor 'khod/ dbang rdzas kyi lha 'od du zhu ba rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rin chen 'byung ldan gyis gtsor byas pa spyan drangs te mchod do// phyi'i dbang gi don du byang chub rdo rje tshig gsum gyi mthar/ rin chen rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/

sangs rgyas kun gyi dbu rgyan dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// dbu rgyan dbang mchog blang bar mdzod// ces gdams nas dbu rgyan spyi bor bcing ste/ dbu rgyan dbang bskur chen po mchog /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ rat+na ku la mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dang bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka sogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par mos/ dbang bskur gyi lha rnams la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas de rnams phung khams skye mched so sor thim pas/ rang ser sna gshin rje'i gshed du gyur pa la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ ser sna gshin rje'i gshed kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no// man chad dmigs bsal ma gtogs des 'gre ste/ 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang la/ nang dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gtso bo 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed du gnas pa la/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// gsung gi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba gdab/ rang dang dbang rdzas rdo rje stong pa'i ngang las dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ snang ba mtha' yas dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dang gnyis su med par mnyam par sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed du bskyed la/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dbu gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub sems kyi rnam pas bdag dang dbang rdzas 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas thim/ de gnyis yum gyi mkha' nas 'thon te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu 'khod/ dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur pa dang*/ dbang gi lha snang ba mtha' yas kyi gtsor byas pa spyan drangs te mchod do// phyi'i dbang gi don du byang chub rdo rje'i tshig gsum gyi mthar/ pad+ma'i rdo rje deng bdag gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ lag pa g.yas su rdo rje gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// zhes sbyin par gdams nas/ lag pa g.yas su rdo rje gtad la/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po mchog /ces pa dang*/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes dang bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ gzhan sngar dang mtshungs/ rang 'dod chags rdo rjer gyur pa la mchod pas mchod/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag go /don yod grub pa nas dril bu'i dbang la/ nang dbang gi don du bla ma phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed dang dbyer med du gnas pa la/ dpal ldan phrin las rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// phrin las rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba gdab/ rang dang dbang rdzas dril bu stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang gnyis su med pa gtso bo'i zhal nas zhugs/

yum gyi mkhar phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed du bskyed la/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs pa dang*/ dbu gtsug nas zhugs te bstim/ de gnyis yum gyi mkha' nas 'thon te dkyil 'khor gyi byang du 'khod pa sogs gzhan gong dang 'dra/ dbang gi lha don yod grub pas gtsor byas pa spyan drangs te mchod/ phyi'i dbang la/ byang chub rdo rje tshig gsum gyi mthar/ ral gri'i rdo rje deng bdag gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis longs// zhes dang lag pa g.yon du dril bu sbyin zhing*/ dril bu'i dbang bskur chen po mchog /zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ.a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes dang bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur ba sogs gzhan sngar dang mtshungs/ rang phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed du gyur pa la mchod pas mchod/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag go /rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang la/ nang dbang gi don du/ bla ma gti mug gshin rje'i gshed du gnas pa la/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// sku yi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig /ces gsol ba gdab/ dbang rdzas med pas/ rang nyid stong pa'i ngang las/ buṃ las 'khor lo buṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug dang gnyis su med pa gtso bo'i zhal nas zhugs/ yum gyi mkhar gti mug gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang gnyis su med par bskyed cing*/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par spyan drangs pa dbu gtsug nas zhugs te bstim/ de yum gyi mkha' nas 'thon te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du 'khod pa sogs 'dra/ dbang gi lha rnam snang gis gtsor byas pa rnams spyan drangs te mchod/ phyi'i dbang gi don du/ byang chub rdo rje tshig gsum gyi mthar/ 'khor lo'i rdo rje deng bdag gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje ming dbang khyod kyis longs// zhes gdams nas/ rdo rje dril bu spyi bor dkrol te/ ming gi dbang bskur chen po mchog /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// gsang ba gsum ni 'byung ba'i gnas// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ kye dpal zhe sdang rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa lha gang la me tog phog pa'i rigs las gras te ming gi dbang bskur/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur la/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang bskur gyi lha de dag phung khams skye mched so sor bstims pas/ rang nyid gti mug gshin rje'i gshed du gyur pa la mchod pas mchod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag go /brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi slad du/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba bsgoms la/

'di la nang dbang bskur ba med pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing rdo rje lag tu gtad pa snying gar bzung*/ snying nang du'ang rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum de 'dra ba zhig bsgoms te slob ma'i dbang ngo*// gnyis pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la bzhi las/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad par rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum du bsgoms pa la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye ho khyed kyi bka' drin gyis// bdag la rang dang gzhan gyi don// rdzogs phyir rdo rje slob dpon dbang*// thugs rje'i stobs dang ldan pas byin// zhes thun mong dang*/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba// mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang*// dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon phrin las yongs su bzung*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa gsang ba bla med pa// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsungs// zhen thun mong ma yin pas gsol ba lan gsum gsum gdab/ rang nyid mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur pa/ de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bla ma gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa rdo rje 'chang chen po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i dbu'i gtsug nas zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ rdo rje'i lam nas byang chub sems kyi rnam pas yum gyi mkhar rdo rje 'chang yab yum gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas thim pas/ slob dpon du dbang bskur ba dang*/ ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan cig tu byung bar mos/ slar yang yum gyi mkha' nas phyir 'thon te/ dbang stegs gzhal yas khang gi dbus su seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du 'khod pa la/ steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ ba dan dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad sprin ltar gtibs pa'i dbus su gnas par mos te/ phyi dbang gi don du/ byang chub rdo rje'i tshig gsum gyi mthar/ nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dam tshig gsum gyi phyir/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lag pa g.yas su byin la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// phyag na rdo rje'i lag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes pas byin pa'i rdo rje de snying gar bzung nas/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems bdag bdag po'i tshul// rdo rje 'di ni thog ma dang tha ma bral ba byang chub kyi sems rig stong dbyer med mtshon par byed pa/ thugs kyi dam tshig tu zung zhig ces so// aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu lag pa g.yon du byin la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ

zhes pas byin pa'i dril bu de 'khrol te dku g.yon par bzung nas/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ aḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa dam pa mchog tu byed// dril bu 'di ni srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag par ston par byed pa/ grag stong dbyer med gsung gi dam tshig tu zung zhig ces so// rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'khyud pa'i tshul du byas la/ yum kun tu bzang mo dang snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen pos lus thams cad du khyab par bsams la/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// zhes gnang ba byin la/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*// sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir// shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs// rnam dag par ni byed pa yin// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du// rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// phyag rgya 'di ni snang stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo/ sku'i dam tshig tu zung zhig ces so// de ltar na dam tshig gsum dang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don rgya chen po gyis shig oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug sogs gong ltar spyan drangs nas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rigs lngas byin gyis brlabs/ yum bzhi dang*/ slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa thogs nas/
