bum pa'i chus gtor zhing*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'i bar gong mi bskyod pa'i chu dbang gi skabs ltar brjod la/ dbang bskur gyi lha rnams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ phung khams skye mched so sor thim pas/ bdag gi snying gar mi bskyod pa sogs nas mkha' 'gro pho mo ba spu'i tshogs la thim pas/ phung khams skye mched lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i skur gyur/ de la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ de la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas me tog gi char phab/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen por mnga' gsol lo// mtha' rten dag pa brjod pa ni/ gzhal yas khang pa ni/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbus kyi gtso bo ni chos kyi dbyings las mi 'gyur bas mthing nag 'gro ba rigs drug la chos ston pas zhal drug phar phyin drug gi dge ba sdud pas phyag drug rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa drug 'joms pas zhabs drug sems can rnams kyi dug lnga dang phung po lnga sbyong zhing ye shes lnga mtshon pas rigs lnga/ khams bzhir 'dzin pa sbyong zhing tshad med pa bzhi mtshon pas yum bzhi/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad du 'dzin pa sbyangs nas rnam thar brgyad mtshon pas phyi nang gi lha mo brgyad/ bdud bzhi/ sgrib pa bzhi/ lta ba bzhir 'dzin pa sbyangs nas rnam thar bzhi mtshon pas sgo ba bzhi'o// rjes su gnang ba ni bcu gsum ste/

sku dang sngags dang phyag mtshan dang*// dbyug tho ral gri mda' gzhu mchod// mig sman me long phrin las bzhi// grub chen gzhan don chos bshad do// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po ni/ gtso bo'i sku byin la/ nyin re bzhin du dus bzhi ru// 'dod lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan par// gyur nas mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub 'dod phyir yi dam sgrubs// gnyis pa sngags ni/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/ zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mthar 'khod par bsam zhing oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥsogs sngags lan gsum bzlas/ me tog phreng ba spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes brjod pa ni lhas slob ma rjes su gzung ba dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes rang gis brjod de/ slob mas lha yi dam du gzung ngo*// gsum pa phyag mtshan ni/ rdo rje tho ba ral gri g.yas// sdigs mdzub zhags pa gtun shing g.yon// rdo rje dang ni dril bu ste// gshin rje'i gshed kyi phyag mtshan 'di// phyi dang nang na yang dag gnas// dpa' bo khyod kyi blang bar gyis// bzhi pa dbyug tho ni/ dbyug pa skad cig tsam gyis dbyug pa gshin rje'i gshed du gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba dbyug tho'i rnam par gyur pa phyag g.yas su byin te/ rdo rje thod dbyug dbyug pa'i sgras// gshin rje la sogs 'dar zhing 'gyel// khams gsum ma lus 'joms pa yi// dpa' bos mtshan ma 'di zung shig /badz+ra daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ lnga pa ral gri ni/ ral gri skad cig tsam gyis ral gri gshin rje'i gshed du gyur/ de 'od du zhu ba ral gri'i rnam par gyur pa phyag g.yas su byin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// las kyi ral gri dam pa 'di// rmongs pa'i mgo bo gcod phyir khyer// badz+ra khaḍ+ga ho/

drug pa mda' gzhu ni/ hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' gzhu byin la/ chos rnams thabs dang shes rab tu// mda' dang gzhu yis rnam mtshon te// bu khyod kyis ni mi 'bral bar// tshar gcod pa dang rjes su gzung*// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga swa/ a nu rā ga mi zhes brjod la mda' phyogs bzhir 'phen pa'i tshul bya/ bdun pa mchod pa ni/ sdug pa'i gdong du bltas nas ni// bltas par gyur pa'i bde ba de// sangs rgyas rnams la phul na ni// skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur// bud med rnams kyis yongs bskor zhing*// kun nas rtse ba'i bde ba de// sangs rgyas rnams la phul na ni// skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur// dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba// las rnams byas pa gang yin pa// sangs rgyas rnams la phul na ni// skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur// brgyad pa mig thur ni/ gser gyi mig thur

praṃ las mig thur bskyed pa ni pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta zhes pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming gi thog ma sa bon du byas pa yin mod/ rwa lo'i dbang chu dang rgya ston gnyis kas sgrib byed praṃ nag po zhes 'di ltar byung ba ci yin ma nges pas yig skyon yin nam brtag byar snang*/ gyis mig gi sgrib byed praṃ nag po gnas pa bsal bar bsams la/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// ji ltar ling thog bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ dgu pa me long ni/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// gshin rje'i gshed po de nyid ni// me long gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs par// bu khyod kyi ni snying la gnas// 'di ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// badz+ra ā dar+sha hoḥ bcu pa phrin las ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje byin la/ zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste// nad la sogs pa zhi bar gyis// rgyas pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa ste// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyis// dbang gi sems kyis dbang bskur te// mos pa rnam bzhi dbang du bsdus// drag po'i bsam pas drag po ste// me yi char sprin dbab par gyis// bcu gcig pa dngos grub sgrub pa ni/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil lam de bzhin ril bu sogs// grub chen brgyad ces bya ba ni// bu khyod kyis ni sgrub par gyis// bcu gnyis pa sems can gyi don bya ba ni/ zhe sdang gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas// zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su// bcom ldan snying rje'i dbang mdzad nas// zhe sdang thams cad zad par gyis// gti mug gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas// gti mug gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su// bcom ldan snying rje'i dbang mdzad nas// gti mug thams cad zad par gyis// nga rgyal gyis mnan 'gro gzigs nas// nga rgyal gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su// bcom ldan snying rje'i dbang mdzad nas// nga rgyal thams cad zad par gyis// ser snas mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas// ser sna gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su// bcom ldan snying rje'i dbang mdzad nas// ser sna thams cad zad par gyis// 'dod chags gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas// 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su// bcom ldan snying rje'i dbang mdzad nas// 'dod chags thams cad zad par gyis// phrag dog gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas// phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su// bcom ldan snying rje'i dbang mdzad nas// phrag dog thams cad zad par gyis// bcu gsum pa chos bshad pa ni/

oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ/ zhabs gnyis kyi 'og tu 'khor lo sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ/ g.yas su dung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ g.yon du dril bu/ dharma a zhes pas pang du po ti byin la/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes pa nas srung bar mdzad/ ces pa'i bar brjod/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad ni/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// de bzhin du kun la sbyar te/ khyad par ni/ rdo rje'i/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ de ltar na rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor skabs su gang bab brjod la bla ma sprul sku las bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ dpe zhing sa sbyang ba dang 'dra/ sprul sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o// gsang ba'i dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal dang*/ phyag rgya phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// gsang ba'i dbang mchog stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bcings/ gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i gtor te byin gyis brlabs/ bla ma gshin rje'i gshed yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyis khar babs pa blangs nas/ btung ba rin po che 'di ni// rdo rje'i lus ni sgrub byed pa// bu khyod rtag par shes gyis la// yid las byung ba'i chu 'di 'thungs// zhes gsung zhing ljags thog tu stsal ba de/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ zhes brjod cing*/ mid pas lus thams cad gang zhig ngag gi dri ma dag nas/ 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed du gyur par bsgoms la/

'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs phye/ lung bstan pa ni/ slob dpon shākya thub pa'i gzugs kyis mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs nas/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// gshin rje'i gshed po de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnam las bton// kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bhur+bhurba swaḥ ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis lung bstan par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin pas 'di la dad par gyis shig de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du bla ma longs sku las gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag rang byin rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ dpe sa bon btab pa dang 'dra/ longs sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ rdo rje 'chang gis 'gro bskyab phyir// yon tan 'byung gnas byin pa ltar// de bzhin slob dpon khyed kyis kyang*// shes rab ye shes dbang bskur stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ gdong g.yogs bcings/ byin gyis brlabs/ bla ma dang gtso bo dbyer med pa'i thugs ka nas phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa sprul te/ phyag rgya'i lag pa g.yas pa nas bzung ste/ rang gi lag pa g.yon du gtad par mos la/ khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che// mtha' yas bde ba ster ba mo// khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis// phyag rgyas rtog pa med dam zhes dri ba ni/ dri chen dri chu la sogs dang*// btsog za de dag yid ches sam// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga la yang 'o bgyid par// bu khyod spro ba yin nam ci// slob mas rnam rtog med par lan gdab pa/ dri chen dri chu la sogs 'tshal// btsog za de dag yid ches so// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga la yang 'o bgyid par// lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro// phyag rgyas dri zhim pos bgos pa'i pad+ma bstan te/

e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na nga gnas te// sangs rgyas nyes pa la sogs pa// bya ba pad+mar ji bzhin byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid na ni rtag tu gnas// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// s+t+waṃ pad+ma bhañja mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes brjod de pang du byon/ rang dang phyag rgya ro langs mar mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar gnyis ka lhar bskyed/ sku gsung thugs dang skye mched kyi lha rnams kyang bkod de/ yab kyi lha rnams pho dang*/ yum gyi lha rnams lha mo'i rnam par gsal btab/ gnyis ka'i mkha' gsang yang dkyus ltar byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar haṃ mgo thur du blta ba/ mgrin par longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug par oṃ mgo gyen du blta ba/ snying gar chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad par hūm̐ mgo thur du blta ba/ lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar aṃ mgo gyen du blta ba/ gsang gnas bde skyong 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa'i lte bar phaṭa rnams gsal gdab/ gshin rje'i gshed yab yum sku gsung thugs dang skye mched kyi lha rnams snyoms 'jug byas/ thams cad kyi thig le haṃ la 'dus/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ lte ba'i aṃ las me sbar/ snying ga'i hūm̐ mgrin pa'i oṃ mes bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ las byang sems phab/ mgrin par dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ gsang gnas su lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsam/ yid kyi dri ma dag nas zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed du gyur par mos la gdong g.yogs phye/ mtha' rten du dbugs dbyung ba ni/ slob ma'i spyi bor lag pa bzhag la/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig

/khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral ba// khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /zhes so// de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bla ma chos kyi sku las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ dpe myu gu skyes pa dang 'dra/ chos sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o// dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ gdong g.yogs bcings/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ rgyal mtshan can gyi khyams mthong nas// der ni 'o ma rab bsgrub bya// 'o ma las sems cig goms nas// phyag rgya chen po rab sgrub 'gyur// zhes brjod la don bshad de/ rgyal mtshan yab kyi rdo rje/ khyams yum gyi mkha'/ 'o ma sgrub pa ni thig le/ dbab bzung bzlog bkram pas zhu ba de lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char la/ de la sems goms pa las rang bzhin lhan skyes bde gsal mi rtog pa skyes pa ni ye shes phyag rgya chen po ste de nyid rab tu bsgrub byar 'gyur ro// ces so// gdong g.yogs phye/ mtha' rten du gzengs bstod pa ni/ deng tshe bdag ni 'bras bur bcas// de ring gson pa 'bras bur bcas// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// de ring sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// zhes brjod do// de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi sku las tshig dbang thob/ ye shes kyi sgrib pa dag phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ dpe ston thog thob pa dang 'dra/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob rung gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o// zhes pas rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pas/

gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang*/ dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul te/ lus longs spyod thams cad kyang 'bul cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams ste bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyis// khyed kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas dbang blang ba'i yul dang*/ len pa po dang*/ len pa'i tshul gsum ga rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang nas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces bden stobs lan gsum brjod do// skabs 'dir gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis bran la/ sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyis cho gas 'jig rten las 'das dang ma 'das pa'i gtor ma dbul lo// gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ lhag gnas byas pa'i slob ma rnams// dang por dkyil 'khor 'jug pa la// khrus 1 byas maṇ+ḍal 2 bgegs bskrad 3 bya// mig 4 dar me tog 5 gtad gsol 6 gdab// rgyud bshags 7 sdom 8 gzung byin gyis brlabs 9 // nang gi sems 10 bskyed gsang 11 bar gdams// dris 12 len byas te nang 13 du 'khrid// phyag 14 'tshal dam 15 gzhag ye shes 16 dbab// gsol 17 gdab ltas 18 brtag me 19 tog dor// gdong 20 dbye dkyil 21 'khor bstan pa'o// dbang la slob ma slob dpon gnyis// dang por maṇ+ḍal gsol ba gdab// bgegs bsal dkyil 'khor gnang ba zhu// chu dang dbu rgyan rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming dbang brtul zhugs so// slob dpon dbang la bzhi yod pa'i// kun la maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab bcas// bum dbang mchod nas rab gnas bya// rnam dag bstan la rjes gnang byin// gsang dbang bskur nas lung bstan bya// shes rab ye shes dbugs dbyung dang*// bzhi pa gzengs bstod bcas pa ste// mtshams sbyor brda sprod tsam ma gtogs// gong gi bdag 'jug kho nas rtogs// zhes pa ltar ro// gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/

mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi nang yid byung gi mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams bya/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ ras bris yin na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs kyi mthar/ khyad par du yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes sogs dang*/ rdul tshon gyi phyogs la/ gshegs gsol gyi nyin ma gtogs pa'i nyi ma snga ma rnams la gong gi khyad par du yang zhes pa'i rjes su rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du zhes sogs brjod la/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba sogs bya'o// rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi nyin rjes chog gi tshe bum pa rnams khyams kyi steng du bzhag la/ cho ga gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi rjes su/ bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs byas la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis mthar/ mtheb srin gyi se gol dang*/ badz+ra muḥ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa dang*/ bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ de nas rol mo dang bcas te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twata ces dang*/ oṃ gi li gi li hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brjod kyin de kho na nyid dran pas/ rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang por gshegs/

de nas g.yas skor gyis rim pas ci bder gshegs su gsol/ gtso bo'i mtshan ma rang gi spyi bor bzhag rdul tshon 'dod pa rnams la lha'i mtshan ma nas sbyin/ gzhan rnams mtha' nas rim pas bsdus te za ma tog la sogs par blugs la/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan drang ba'i cho ga'am/ mi nus na'ang rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung la sogs par gshegs su gsol/ thig rjes rnams dri zhim po'i chus mtha' nas rim gyis phyis te rjes mi mngon par byas la/ bkra shis kyi glu dang me tog gi sil mas phyogs kun tu 'thor zhing*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am dpa' bo'i ston mo la sogs pa'i dga' ston rgya chen po bya'o// gang zhig la brten rim gnyis bsgom bzlas lhur bgyid pa'i// rnal 'byor pa des las tshogs rab 'byams dbang 'byor zhing*// nyi ma'i bur bcas yid srubs dpung las rnam rgyal ba'i// mchog dngos grub pa bde ster lha mchog dus kyi dgra// 'gro 'dul ye shes rten dang brten pa'i gzugs rnam nyid// dbang gzhu dar bab lang tshor sgrub kyin mchod pa dang*// bdag gzhan 'jug dang dbang bskur cho ga mkhas grub kyi// zhal lung 'dab brgya'i kha 'byed sgeg mo'i 'gram chang 'di// sngon byon dam pas spel ba'i dbang rgyun mtho ris klung*// ma brtags gshar rgyug drang srong gsus par bcings pa dang*// smin byed btags pas bstan pa gyi nar bgyid 'gyur gyi// dwogs pas mdun bsu lhag bsam bha gi ra thas byas// rgyud gzhung dgongs pas rnam gsal min pa dpyis 'byin du// dpyad don tshul bzhin 'doms la bsnyengs bral blo gros 'di// dran dbang gzhan gyi blo ni ma byin blangs snyam du// dogs pas tshogs gsum gad mor khong nas dgod pa 'dra// rnam dkar dge tshogs chu skyes khrod nas 'phos pa'i dris// lus can bung ba'i tshogs rnams gsang chen theg pa'i tshal// mgron du gnyer byas smin grol gdams pa'i sbrang rtsis 'tsho// lung rtogs lang tsho dar bab 'phur lding bsgyur phyir bsngo// zhes dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po gdong drug lha nyer gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga smin byed 'dab brgya phye ba'i 'gram chang zhes bya ba 'di ni/

dpal sa skya'i phrin las kyi snang chen 'gyed pa'i mdo sngags rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas bzang po pa'i gsung gis/ sgrub thabs dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di dag tshig don bsdus ches pas rjes 'jug 'ga' zhig gis cho ga yang dag pa zhig 'byor dka' ba mchis pas/ shin tu gsal ba zhig gyis zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ rwa lo chen po/ rje btsun grags pa/ mkhas grub rgya ston/ rje ngor chen yab sras la sogs pa lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa rnams kyi gsung rab dang mi 'gal bar/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sder btags pas/ lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
